title: Hirvi Mirchi Thecha
description: Fiery Maharashtrian green chilli and peanut thecha, pounded with garlic and served in small spoonfuls.
steps: Heat half of the oil in a pan and sauté the green chillies for 3-4 minutes until blistered and soft.
Remove the chillies and in the same pan toast the cumin seeds and garlic for 1 minute.
Add the roasted peanuts and salt to a mortar or grinder with the chillies and garlic.
Pound or pulse to a coarse chunky paste, keeping some texture.
Stir in the coriander leaves and the remaining raw oil and serve in small portions.
